{{Top|leg}}
Impact [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was designed to help absorb some of the wear-and-tear [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could have encountered in an active workplace. The '''impact armor Mark III''' was the best protection available for non-combat droids and increased their survivability in hostile situations.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]], ''a droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
